governance_archetypes.label: National inspectorate plus qualification-content model
governance_archetypes.control: England-only boundary and DfE subject-content source separate from exam-board specifications.

governance_archetypes.label: Subnational quality-framework and curriculum-goals model
governance_archetypes.control: Flanders-only boundary and separate curriculum/quality source roles.

governance_archetypes.label: Federal coordination plus Land curriculum model
governance_archetypes.control: KMK source family is federal context only; Bavaria is representative Land overlay only.

governance_archetypes.label: State standards with federal accountability context
governance_archetypes.risk: National-US inspection, accreditation, or standards claim.
governance_archetypes.control: California state standards are local; U.S. Department of Education material is federal accountability context only.

school_owned_boundary: Ofsted evidence gathering, leadership, safeguarding, attendance, support, and implementation evidence belongs to the school and inspectorate process.
Product evidence can support curriculum reasoning only; it cannot supply inspection evidence by itself.
proof_required_to_close: England source refresh by a country/source reviewer.
Exam-board-specific source allowlist if assessment mapping is ever authorised.
Teacher/economics review of all terminology substitutions.
Human approval before any local edition or public/school-facing output.

school_owned_boundary: OK quality-development evidence is owned by the school and inspection process.
Product crosswalks can support curriculum reasoning but cannot supply school-quality proof.
proof_required_to_close: Flemish source refresh with exact curriculum goal IDs.
Flemish assessment/source decision if assessment mapping is ever authorised.
Human approval before any local edition or school-facing output.

descriptors.boundary_label: KMK context plus Bavaria Land overlay
school_owned_boundary: Land school-quality, support, and assessment records are not supplied by this descriptor.
The descriptor is an internal source map; it is not a German or Bavarian compliance artefact.
proof_required_to_close: German country/source review for KMK and Bavaria boundaries.
Bavaria teacher/economics review of terminology and concept placement.
Land-specific inspection/evaluation source refresh if school-quality claims are ever considered.
Human approval before any local edition or Germany-facing output.

descriptors.boundary_label: California state standards plus U.S. federal accountability context
school_owned_boundary: District curriculum decisions, student supports, accountability reports, and any accreditation evidence are outside this descriptor.
Federal ESSA context does not turn product evidence into school accountability evidence.
proof_required_to_close: California source refresh with exact HSS-PoE standards selected.
Teacher/economics review of U.S. terminology and examples.
Legal/claims review before any accountability, district, accreditation, or public wording.
Human approval before any local edition or U.S.-facing output.
